description: A fully-featured pivot table component that transforms flat data into a matrix view. Supports multi-level row and column dimensions, multiple aggregations, filters, and totals.

parameters.name: AllowDragDrop
parameters.description: When true, shows a checkbox tree instead of the Unused zone in the configuration panel. Default: false.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Custom template for column dimension header cells.

parameters.name: ColumnFieldKeys
parameters.description: Keys of fields placed in the row area.

parameters.name: ColumnHeadersWidth
parameters.description: Heading shown in the empty state when no data is available.

parameters.name: ColumnHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom template for row dimension header cells.

parameters.name: DataCellTemplate
parameters.description: Fires after the pivot data is refreshed or recomputed.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Source data items for in-memory pivot transformation.

parameters.name: DataProviderType
parameters.description: XMLA (OLAP) data provider. Used when is .

parameters.name: EmptyTitle
parameters.description: When true, shows a loading spinner instead of the table.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Determines which data provider backs the pivot table. Default: Client.

parameters.name: FilterFields
parameters.description: Value field configurations for the data area.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS width applied to row dimension header cells (e.g. "120px", "15%").

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: When true, enables drag-and-drop in the configuration panel. Default: true.

parameters.name: OnConfigurationChanged
parameters.description: CSS width applied to the wrapper div (e.g. "100%", "800px").

parameters.name: OnDataChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the pivot configuration changes.

parameters.name: RowFieldKeys
parameters.description: All available field definitions for the pivot table.

parameters.name: RowHeadersWidth
parameters.description: CSS width applied to column header cells (e.g. "120px", "15%").

parameters.name: RowHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom template for data cells (inner matrix values).

parameters.name: ShowConfigurationPanel
parameters.description: Filter field configurations. Key = field key, Value = allowed values.

parameters.name: ShowFieldTree
parameters.description: When true, shows the filter bar. Default: true.

parameters.name: ShowFilterBar
parameters.description: When true, shows the configuration panel. Default: true.

parameters.name: ValueFields
parameters.description: Keys of fields placed in the column area.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: CSS height applied to the wrapper div (e.g. "400px", "60vh").

parameters.name: XmlaDataProvider
parameters.description: Server-side data provider. When set, overrides Items and calls GetPivotDataAsync.
